description: Release versions as the node reads them (`is_release_version` in apps/cli/src/protocol/frames.rs): an `agent.update` version or an `availableVersion` the server accepts must be one the node accepts. Checked by both sides.
comparisonsDescription: SemVer precedence as the node orders release versions (`compare_release` in apps/cli/src/update/homebrew.rs; build metadata ignored, an empty pre-release identifier kept as one): each entry is [a, b, order] with order -1, 0 or 1 (every pair of the valid versions above, plus edge cases). The server's `compareReleaseVersions` must give the same order; both sides check every entry.
